I am too old to carry heavy fertilizer bags, and beans fix nitrogen in the soil so they do not need chemicals. My grandchildren help me weed and harvest, but I will hire a few young men to clear the plot at the start of the season. I spread manure from our cows because it is free and makes the soil soft, and I keep my own bean seeds from last year because they never fail me.
